lines.text: The people gather around Aaron, who fashions their gold earrings into a molten calf with an engraving tool.
Aaron builds an altar before the calf, and the next day the people offer burnt offerings and peace offerings.
Moses pleads with the LORD and asks Him to remember His oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Israel.
Caleb hears the shouting and tells Moses of war, and Moses shatters the tablets and burns the calf.
The tribe of Benjamin gathers around Moses, and that day about three thousand of the people fall dead.
